_note: The Difficulty control (docs/song-builder-prd.md B10; DECISIONS.md: Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced, default Intermediate). What each level lets the Generator write: `maxCells` = the finest rhythm grid (8 = eighths only, 16 = sixteenth-note gallops and fills); `riffs` = Intro riffs (single notes and octaves) or strummed chords only; `shapes` = shape sizes in rhythm parts (`two` = 2-note power chords only, null = the recipe's mix); `soloStyles` = the lead styles a Generator-written solo may use (a solo sent from the Chords page always plays as previewed). The picking-hand cap per level is in data/playability.json (`picking.caps`). A card's own Options can't pick what the level rules out: those choices show greyed with the level they need.
